title: 1 App To Rule Them All
body: Finally an app that truly allows me to organise everything in my brain in a way that makes sense. I basically don’t use my brain anymore and simply do what’s on my list and my life has never felt more on track. If you too want to outsource a good 27% of your thinking, then this app makes it possible.
author: BitterButterbean

title: Maturing
body: I’ve resubscribed, having had the email detailing the maturation of the app. So far, I like what I see. Happy to support.
author: BobInCork
